label: Everyone
description: The reserved rule subject unioned into every caller except super admin (src/domain/grants.ts EVERYONE_ROLE). Never assignable to a user. Holds only what EVERY signed-in account needs whatever its role: the app shell (who am I, my preferences, my exports, the batch transport), my notifications, the assets I hold, and the two company-wide walls - the board (read, post, poll, kudos, react, reply, vote) and the suggestion box (read, submit, vote). Outside the two walls every rule reaches the caller's own rows or is refused in the service for anyone else, so a role an admin builds in Access Management starts from a working app and nothing private about anybody else.

levels.why: Own user record (users/me): identity, capabilities and the grantable scope tiers the SPA gates everything on. Without it the app cannot start, so it cannot depend on which role an account holds.
Own UI preferences (theme, tab badges). Every preferences route is caller-scoped in the service (routes/preferences.ts), so no path id reaches another user's row.
List own long-running operations (exports). A bare collection pattern is the list call only; the `me` rule beside it decides the rows.
Poll own operations. An export any role is granted finishes as an operation, so polling it cannot depend on the role.
List own in-app notifications. A bare collection pattern is the list call only; which rows come back is decided by the `me` rule beside it.

Read, mark read, snooze and dismiss own notifications, and nobody else's. Write is the least level PATCH needs; the collection mounts no create and no delete (the server emits rows, and the table has no delete_time), so write reaches nothing else.
List the assets you are holding. Says nothing about which rows come back: actorScope finds no broad item read and resolves the breadth to own, bound as `assigned_to = me`.
The company board: announcements, posts, polls and kudos.

Edit and soft-delete own posts, polls and kudos. A board row's code is owned by its author, so `me` reaches only the caller's own. Creating needs no level: posts arrive through the `post` and `giveKudos` verbs, and the collection-level write that creates official announcements stays HR's.
List the suggestion box and submit to it. A bare collection pattern is the list and the create only; the item rules beside it decide the rows.
Read every suggestion on the box. An anonymous one carries no submitter on the wire (toSuggestionResource), and the list's submitter filter refuses to unmask one (listSuggestions).
Edit and withdraw own suggestions. A suggestion's code is owned by its submitter, so `me` reaches only the caller's own.

allow.why: The SPA's multi-read transport. GET sub-requests only, and each re-enters the whole auth and authz chain (routes/batch.ts), so it grants no read of its own.

Clear own unread state in one call; the service updates only rows whose recipient is the caller. A collection-level verb, which compileGrant encodes broad (scope all, no match code) so it is reachable at all.

Confirm receipt by scanning the tag on an asset handed to you. Scoped `**` because an asset's code is flat and custody moves, so no scope token can say 'held by me'; holder-only is enforced in the service (acknowledgeAsset refuses anyone but `assigned_to`).
Post to the board, or open a poll. The verb forces the kind to post or poll (routes/announcements.ts announcementPost), so it never makes an official announcement.
React to any post or reply.
Reply to any post. The service refuses a locked post.
Mark a post read (own read receipt).
Vote in a poll. The service refuses a closed one.
Upvote a suggestion (one vote per person, toggled).
Downvote a suggestion (one vote per person, toggled).

excluded.why: Own HR record and self-service (profile, leave, pay, claims) belong to the employee role. An account can exist with no employee record (an external auditor), and a role without HR self-service is a legitimate thing for an admin to build.
Item reads of any asset: a flat code carries no owner, so any item read here would be every asset in the company. The held-assets list is enough to see what you hold.
Fan-out reads decided per collection from each caller's own grants; granting them here would add nothing and could only widen.
The collection-level write is the create that makes an official announcement, which is HR's. Everyone posts through the `post` and `giveKudos` verbs instead.

excluded.pattern: announcements.*.publish | unpublish | disable | enable | lock | unlock | pin | unpin

excluded.why: Triage: HR answers and folds duplicates together, and `similar` exists only to serve `merge`.
AI drafting runs on the free plan's Workers AI allowance; granted per role in the ACL, not to every account.
